title: Father and Baby Stevie & Joe, 1951 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black and white snapshot taken on June 17, 1951, depicting a proud father (Joe) holding his baby (Stevie) in an outdoor yard. The father wears classic 1950s pleated trousers and a button-up shirt. In the background stands a rustic wooden garage housing a vintage car. Significantly, June 17, 1951, was Father's Day in the United States, giving this portrait special historical and sentimental context.
